conciseReport: All four canonical criteria passed in independent launcher-started runs with criterion-owned initial, transition and final PNGs. Each run began with no loaded layers and added one temporary default Surveyor - Service layer. Searching and clearing preserved that layer and its order; the catalogue restored and the map stayed visible in GIS without an error or sign-in interruption. Each temporary layer was removed after final evidence. Browser identity observed: Google Chrome 155.0.8059.40. An initial screenshot save failed because the handoff screenshot directory did not yet exist; the directory was created and the required capture succeeded before interaction. Guide assessment is left to the documentation stage; this tester read only the three prescribed remote inputs.
